title: Grokbot Characters (Rege Lab)
brief: A Rege Lab page with six little Grokbot character expressions to play with, plus downloadable editable CoAnimato files. A creative asset resource for bot and character design.
details: Rege Lab's "Grokbot Characters" page is a demo of image-to-SVG character animation made with AI agents inside CoAnimator — the Grokbot character playing as a 13-second SVG animation alongside its timeline and AI agent. Rather than a code library, it is a showcase you can edit: download the animation file, open it in the free CoAnimator app, and ask your AI agent to change the expressions, motion, or colors.
